build_identity_semantics: BuildFingerprint is a caller-supplied, format-limited reproducibility label frozen and echoed exactly across the visual and wrapper receipts. It is not authorization, worker identity, a signature, provenance, attestation or proof that two executables are equivalent.
compile_semantics: Compile one visual Document v2 through the additive native-image/vector/static-Text compositor, independently freeze the same canonical DocumentHash, then compile strict PNG, expression and pinned-font Text providers. Publish only after all provider manifests exactly match enabled frozen assets, explicit font authorization and every stage identity/configuration cross-binding.
excluded_responsibilities: Temporal video, dynamic text paint, rich text, font fallback/system fonts, bidi inference, Text transitions, audio, vector strokes/curves, external resources, filesystem/network authorization, signatures, publication, scheduling, cache and muxing remain outside this v2 pipeline.
failure_semantics: Any context, configuration, document, static-Text subset, binding, resource, provider, profile, geometry, time, hash or receipt mismatch fails closed with nil Program or a zero Result. No partial source cache, Surface, output Frame or PNG Artifact is published.
manifest_semantics: Bind one DocumentHash to defensive native-PNG, expression and Text manifests plus the transition-handle and scoped vector-transition contracts. Asset IDs/indexes/kinds/hashes/viewports, font identities and retained-surface accounting are checked against the same frozen document without cross-kind aliasing.
ownership_semantics: CompileV2 borrows the caller Document, PNG bindings, font bindings, encoded PNG bytes and ShapeProviders only until return. A successful Program retains immutable dependency programs/providers, intrinsic source Surfaces and value receipts; accessors are defensive and concurrent arbitrary-order renders are safe.
receipt_semantics: Bind the source manifest, ordered strict native/expression/Text compositor receipts, live target Surface hash, output-color frame hash and final PNG artifact hash. Every concrete provider request is replayed before output conversion; serialized receipts are unsigned structural claims and never offline pixel provenance.
render_semantics: Evaluate one exact timeline time or composition frame, mix native PNG, viewport-vector expression and pinned-font static Text surfaces in frozen background-to-foreground order, apply compositor transform/crop/opacity, convert the complete linear RGBA16 target to straight sRGB RGBA8, then emit the deterministic stored-DEFLATE PNG profile.
resource_semantics: Apply every dependency hard limit plus overflow-checked aggregate retained-source, document-metadata, canonical/provider compile and sequential visual/color/PNG runtime budgets. Text compile accounting includes already-retained native/expression surfaces and the Text provider's complete compile-working envelope.
